h1: AI Unboxing Video Maker: Open the Parcel from One Photo
lead: AIVideosUGC makes an unboxing video from a product photo or a product link. You get a script, an AI person on camera, a voice, and a finished clip. No sample to mail and no camera crew. Pick 6 to 30 seconds, then download it or send it to TikTok or Meta (Facebook and Instagram).
benefits_h2: Benefits of Using an AI Unboxing Video
benefits_lead: A finished unboxing, with a spoken line and an edited clip, instead of a filming day.

benefits.d: The unboxing comes back with a script, an AI person on camera, an AI voice, and a clip you can post. You do not write instructions for a creator or book a filming day.

benefits.t: Pay for the Clip, Not a Shoot
benefits.d: A 15-second unboxing uses 60 credits. Credits are the units in your monthly plan. Plans start at $24.50 a month for 200 credits. If making the clip fails, those credits come back.
Change the opening line, the on-camera person, the voice, or the language, and make another clip from the same photo.

benefits.t: Refresh an Ad Seen Too Often
benefits.d: When shoppers have seen an ad too often, change the opening, the on-camera person, or the video shape. You do not book another filmed unboxing.
You can change the words, the tone, the on-camera person, and the language. The editor on this page follows those choices.
You can use finished clips in ads you pay for and in posts you do not pay to boost. They have no watermark, so no logo is stamped on the file.

faq.q: What is an AI unboxing video?
faq.a: A short ad of a parcel opening onto your product. AIVideosUGC writes the script, picks an AI person and a voice, and makes the clip from a photo or a product link. Show the main item first, then the pieces that come with it. You do not film it.

faq.q: How do I make an unboxing video with AI?
faq.a: Upload a photo or paste a product link. You do not need a photo of the box. Describe the shipping package and the tissue. The tool writes the script and picks an AI person and a voice. Then download the clip, or send it to TikTok or Meta.

faq.q: Which page should I use for an unboxing ad?
faq.a: Use this page when the clip should show the parcel opening onto the item you sell. For a general product ad, start from [creator-style (UGC) video ads](page:video-ads).

faq.q: Is there a free unboxing video?
faq.a: No. There is no free plan. Credits are the units in a plan. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Pro is $35 for 300 credits. Premium is $63 for 600 credits. A 15-second unboxing uses 60 credits. The download has no watermark. If making the clip fails, those credits come back.

faq.q: Can I use the clip in a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. You can use the file in ads, and it has no watermark. The on-camera person is made by AI, not a buyer, so do not post the clip as a customer review.

faq.q: Which sizes and lengths can I download?
faq.a: Choose a tall phone shape (9:16), a square (1:1), a wide shape (16:9), 4:3, or 3:4. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Use the tall 9:16 size for TikTok and Instagram Reels. Check words printed on the box, and fix a wrong letter in the editor. You can send the clip to TikTok or Meta from that same editor.

faq.q: Can I make opens for a whole catalog?
faq.a: Yes. Run a batch, many clips at once, from the product photos or links you list, instead of one clip at a time. Each clip shows its credit cost before it starts. A developer can send that batch through the API, so your own software can start the same jobs.

faq.q: Will an AI open replace a filmed one?
faq.a: Use the AI unboxing to try more versions, with a new on-camera person, voice, or language. Keep a filmed unboxing when you want a real customer on camera. The AI person is not a buyer.

faq.q: Will TikTok or Meta reject an AI unboxing ad?
faq.a: Do not post the clip as a customer review. Before you pay to run the ad, read the current TikTok or Meta rule and add any label it asks for.

definition.title: What Is an AI Unboxing Video?
paras: An AI unboxing video is a short ad of a parcel opening onto your product. AIVideosUGC writes the script, picks an AI person on camera and an AI voice, and makes the clip from a photo or a product link. Nothing is filmed.

On-screen captions and a song from the music library are added in the editor. Credits are the units in your monthly plan, and you see that cost before a clip starts. You can switch language. You can run a batch, many clips at once, for the products you list. A developer can start that work through the API, so your own software can start the same jobs. Each clip can be a tall phone shape (9:16), a square (1:1), or a wide shape (16:9). 4:3 is a little wide, and 3:4 is a little tall. You can use the clip in ads, and it has no watermark.

more_sections.lead: Seven kinds of unboxing. None of these cards is a customer review.

items.d: A skincare shop shows the jar coming out of tissue, with a short spoken line about what is in the box.
A beauty shop opens the set, main item first, then the extras, with captions on the clip.
An apparel shop lifts the clothing out of the shipping package so the shape is clear in the first second.
A food brand opens the carton and ends on the bottle or the bag you sell.
An electronics shop lays the device and the cable in one view as the box opens.
A fitness shop opens the parcel onto the band or the bottle, with an AI person from the actor library.
A home shop shows the box, the tissue, and the item on a table, then sends the finished clip to TikTok or Meta.
